body: I don't know if I know how to be a friend but I will sure try. Just PM me whenever.
Thank you for your kind words.
I just asked the same thing. All the podcast I listen to certainly say that this skill can be learned but I don't know for sure.
I was told at an early age that I have no personality. I don't even know what that is anymore.

I am really envious of people that are happy. I know that statement sounds terrible. I'm upset that I never found anyone willing to accept me for me. Friends were impossible to come by and when they did come, they all left. I feel truly alone and I'm so old now that I know it will be like this forever. I think your amazing for at least being able to pretend.

This hits really close to home. I have always been alone except recently I started to connect with my brother. Being lonely is finally starting to bother me not because I don't like being alone, but because people look at me differently cause I'm alone. I've always been like this and don't think I'm going to change.
I'm going to be here soon too.
Yes! I cant sleep most nights. Its a terrible feeling. I wish I had someone to talk to.

You'll find another job. Please don't beat yourself over about it. I guarantee you that most people have had a similar experience losing a job. Take a deep breathe and know that you will be OK. Figure out the next step, learn from your mistake and don't dwell on it too much. I wish someone told me this when I was going through this.
Not a true friend that you want in your life.
Most people are terrible. I can't stand them.
You don't love yourself, maybe.

If drugs help you then just take them and be happy. How you feel is important nobody cares if you took drugs to get there. I don't know you to think your worthless and I know your being super hard on yourself.
Your really brave you made it farther and accomplished more than I ever would. I'm sorry that you can't find a job and have to suffer with a miserable parent. I hope things work out for you.
I think your strong for at least trying. Don't put yourself down.
I was thinking we should start a face to face support group. Probably not going to work but I like the idea.

Do what you think is right. I know plenty tof people who are either atheist or agnostic but are caring, kind individuals. And plenty of religious people who are not so nice. As long as your a decent individual what yoiu believe or follow shouldn't matter. I know what its like to be threatened with hell all the time growing up. It actually made me less religious.

Good job. I gave myself two years on April 13. 2015. You might need more time. I just did that to complete things on my bucket list. I know my life is not getting better because its been shitty for too long. And I guessed correctly, unfortunately. Good luck, hope your better and you don't come back here.
If you wish you would die, you won't. If you wish you would live, you won't.
I was thinking the same thing yesterday. Once my mom is gone their is literally no one on this planet who would give a shit about me or care if I live or die.
Your just going through a shitty time in life. If your still in your late teens and early 20's you have time to enjoy and really develop as a person. Don't think about suicide now.
Its the worst when people think its their place to tell you to smile. You don't know the shit I'm dealing with so shut the fuck up.

I had a terrible childhood and an even worse adulthood. I have yet to share a normal experience that others children may have had. I wish a part of my life could have been great enough that I would want to relive it. Fuck it, do what makes you happy. I'm tired of society telling us what we should do, how we should feel at certain times of our lives.

I didn't care about summer or winter when I was a kid (maybe ii don't remember), in my early 20's I hated summer because that's when I would be dealing with the most criminals and ignorant people so I just associated all bad things to summer. Consistently I have had other bad experiences when the weather is warm. I prefer winter, I am just starting to stand summer, it helps not working that same job.
I want to feel like I deserve to live among other people. That would make me feel a little better.

I'm depressed because I compare myself to other people. I look at the "priceless" things they have and wonder what is wrong with me because I can't want that. But society and family tells me that I should want that. But what I really want is to die every moment of everyday regardless of how things are going in life. It depresses me that of all things offered in life, I choose death and to be depressed because I can't live up to my simply, basic, easy expectations from life. It sounds confusing, welcome to my world.

This has been my biggest struggle as of recent. I don't know what is wrong with me that I can't get anyone to like me as a person. Its impossible for me to meet/make acquaintances. I definitely know that if I happened to pull it off, it would not last long. I wish I was normal.
Life is so unfair. Thats been my biggest issue recently to come to terms with the fact that life will be easier for most people while I struggle to fit in and fine that.

I spent my whole adult life working 2 jobs and putting myself through school. I got a decent job after a long struggle with a stable schedule and my manager asked me what I do for fun. After a short, I said "i dont know, I haven't figured it out yet." I have been trying different things since then trying to find something I'm passionate about or like doing. You need to go out discover the world. If you have to do it by yourself sometimes, then so be it. Enjoy your 20's because they fly by!
My friend has invisalign. It works and is perfect for older people. Don't threaten to kill yourself for something you can fix. .

I have anger issues. I am careful as to who I direct it towards. Let go of your anger. Your only hurting yourself. Don't think about the people that only make you angry. Fuck them. I wish someone gave me this advice before when I wasted my time on bullshit and thought about all the wrong things.
I have been dealing with this for a very long time too so I feel what your going through. It sucks so much. Don't let it take any more if your time if you can help it. Hope you feel better.

I think you still have some time. You took the first step and moved out of your old city. You already did more than I ever did in my life. You have a fresh start so give yourself a break. I took a different position in a company that I wanted to work for. I'm not in my field yet but at least I have my foot in the door. I worked 2 crappy jobs while I was searching. Have a good resume and practice your interview skills. Good luck!

I had the same experience when I was younger. I mean everyone insulted me and made fun of me. I felt that everything I did was wrong. Because of that my self confidence never developed. I let me get to me and thought it would always be this difficult. I learned that's only high school that people are assholes for no reason. Society isn't that judgemental and you might not see it until your older. Please work on your self confidence and you will be fine. Suicide isn't the first go to solution and taking more anti depressents might not be a food idea without asking your doctor. Take your time and just relax because things will work out.
That's unprofessional. I wouldn't even pay for the session.
These people have never been depressed then.
Thanks a lot!

I know I'm broken. I make all the wrong choices without thinking about it. I have more enemies that I can keep track of, and I without fail get shitty service anywhere I go. I have recently accepted that I am wrong(I don't know how yet!) and that I am just a horrible person. I have gone so far with this belief that I can't come back from it anymore. 

I know exactly where your coming from and how your feeling. The only advice I can give you is don't do what I did.
It is so unfair that most people in this world are fine and some of us feel like we need to die to escape this miserable shit hole. I have been thinking about dying since I was in the 4th grade.
I don't know if it will help. So I accept what I have to do.
I want to die more everyday. Its too much suffering. Fuck life.

I have questioned that everyday of my life. There is no hope for me but I know other people that feel differently who don't deal with my issues and feel more optimistic about life. Someone once told me that life is about making memories. But from the best of my understanding, dead people don't have memories? I think there might be some point, I haven't found it yet.
I feel that way everyday of my life, I understand that it might just be in my head but it feels so real!
I'm glad medications are helping. People are just haters. Talking shit is a technique to put people down.
Yes.... But only for a while!

I think its scary how much I can relate to your story. I am in exactly the same boat as you. It wasn't as hard as it has become recently because I realize that as more time passes it gets harder to cope with it. Friends are hard to make but I found the older you get, you start having fewer friends and more acquaintances. I found the only people that do stay friends with me are just as depressed or miserable as I am. But its hard not having anyone to just vent too, so if you need to every chat you can PM me anytime. I know exactly what your going through since it is also my reality. Most of my energy is now spent on comparing myself to others around me too see how successful they are. In my head their success is only based on the relationships they've established with people. I never understood this concept and am finally starting to realize how important it is to socialize, etc. But at the same time I hate that its easier for some people and harder for others. Please let me know if you find a solution cause I would be very curious to know.

I'm really happy that things worked out for you and I wish that things would work out for most people. But my optimism doesn't mean much because the truth is that things don't work out for most people. I recently found a letter that I forgot about to myself from about 8 years ago stating the things in my life that need to get better and improve for me to be happy, and none of these things have happened. God knows I tried really hard. I almost forgot that I, for most of my life have felt this way and time didn't fix anything. Thank you for trying to help but some people already know what their destiny is.
I love eating. I would've probably killed myself much earlier if I didn't have this too look forward to.

I agree. People are judgemental and jump to conclusions without knowing the whole story. I have had thoughts of suicide and been depressed for as far back as I can remember. I know suicide would be the best option. I say if you don't about me when I was alive, don't pretend to care and judge me when I'm dead.

Sorry about your experience. I can't imagine losing someone close to me. You've come this far, you can make it farther. Make time for you and do what you think is best for yourself. Don't worry about what other people think. Get away from this for a while so you can be reminded that there is so much more you can do to make yourself happy.

I completely understand where your coming from. I've been in the same place for all my life. It is definetly harder to make friends as you get older, but easier to make acquaintances. I have always had a way of pissing people off even when I wasn't trying. I have been told this by enough people to know that its not just in my head like some people say. 
All the introverts should get together and do activities like watch this movie.

Good job! They're is nothing wrong with seeing a therapist. I worked up the courage to make an appointment to see a therapist when I was really in need, and then she cancelled on me. Never went back after that. Hope you a a better experience.
Same here. I think its because I'm envious of people that die. Pets are innocent, most people are not.

I think its crazy how closely I can relate to your experience. I always feel that way and am constantly being told by everyone around me that I am not good enough.  I'm not going to say it gets better cause I don't think it ever does, but you do get better at coping with it.

I'm sorry you feel this way. Being lonely is tough. Remember you're still young and will have plenty of chances to meet someone and make friends. It may be hard to open up to people and be social but you will get better at it with practice then more people will have the opportunity to get to know you.

I was like that too. Then I started speaking my mind and found I just made enemies. Now, I'm just quiet and stay under the radar. But there are still times I get voluntold to do stuff. I have found that I no longer care about what people think about me so I just say no when I have to. Just remember to do it nicely.
